title: Scene Viewport
description: The interactive canvas where you place, move, rotate, and resize entities in real time. Use the Scene Viewport to arrange scenes, snap layouts to the grid, and launch game previews.

blocks.content: The **Scene Viewport** sits in the center of the [Editor Overview](interface/editor_overview) and renders your active scene in real time. You can select entities on the canvas, transform them with visual handles, and preview your game from the bottom overlay toolbar.

items.title: Transform Gizmo
items.desc: Move, resize, and rotate selected entities directly on the canvas.

items.title: Grid & Snapping
items.desc: Align entities to pixel grids and smart guides for clean layouts.

items.title: Quick Spawning
items.desc: Right-click anywhere on the canvas to create or paste entities at the cursor.

items.title: Instant Preview
items.desc: Click **Play** or **Update** in the bottom bar to test changes live.

blocks.content: The viewport includes the interactive canvas and a floating toolbar at the bottom center.

rows: Renders visible **World** and **User Interface** layers, selection boxes, and collider wireframes.
Bounding box around the selected entity. Drag inside to move, drag edge or corner handles to resize, or drag the rotation handle to rotate.
Displays the live pointer coordinates in world pixels on the left side of the bottom overlay bar.
Magnet button in the bottom overlay bar that toggles grid and smart-guide snapping.
Grid button in the bottom overlay bar that shows or hides the alignment grid.
Launches the game preview, or updates a running preview with your latest scene edits.

blocks.content: Right-clicking on the canvas opens a context menu. The available actions depend on whether you right-click empty space or a selected entity.

rows: Spawns an **Empty Entity**, **Sprite**, **Shape**, **Text**, [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap), or user interface (UI) element at the cursor position.
Pastes copied entities centered at the clicked coordinates.
Copies, cuts, or clones the selected entity.
Bring to Front / Send to Back
Increases or decreases the entity **Z-Index** by 1 within its layer.
Saves the entity and its children as a reusable [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs).
Prevents accidental selection or movement on the canvas.
Hides or shows the entity in the viewport.
Enables or disables the entity at runtime.
Removes the selected entity and its children from the scene.

blocks.message: Press **Esc** to clear your selection, then use **Quick Actions** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) to toggle camera bounds, UI borders, and collider wireframes.

blocks.content: You can create new entities directly at any world coordinate from the canvas context menu.

items: Hold **Space** and drag with the left mouse button to pan the **Scene Viewport** to your target area.
Hover over **Create Entity**, select a target layer, and click **Sprite**, **Shape**, **Text**, or **Tilemap**. The new entity spawns at the clicked position.

blocks.content: Use the transform gizmo and grid snapping to position and resize entities.

items: In the bottom overlay bar, click the magnet button to turn **Snap On**.
Click an entity on the canvas to select it and show its transform gizmo.
Drag inside the selection box to move the entity along the grid. Hold **Ctrl** while dragging to temporarily ignore snapping.
Drag a corner handle while holding **Shift** to resize the entity with a locked aspect ratio.

blocks.message: Clicking a child entity on the canvas selects its root parent by default. Hold **Ctrl** and click the child entity to select it directly.

blocks.content: Use these mouse and keyboard shortcuts in the **Scene Viewport** and UI editor. For **Tilemap Editor** and **Shape Editor** shortcuts, see [Shortcuts Reference](interface/shortcuts).

items.description: Pan the viewport camera (hold **Space** and drag)
Zoom in or out toward the pointer
Select entity (or drag on empty space to box-select)
Select a nested child entity directly
Add or remove an entity from the selection
Lock aspect ratio while dragging a resize handle
Invert grid snapping while moving or resizing
